cinemaStudio.renderAndStitch: Each generation is one finished clip (cuts included). There is no timeline editor in Cinema Studio itself: clips live in project folders; continuity comes from Extend, Elements and the shared Director settings; final assembly happens outside (Higgsfield Edit / Canvas / export). The only timeline UI is the reference-video trimmer. (inferred from the absence of any NLE strings in the CS bundles)

mixedMedia.preview: Generate preview frame — 'Generate one frame with your current settings before creating the full video.' (POST /chains/mixed-media-preview, 'Preview costs: N credits')
mixedMedia.api: POST /chains/mixed-media {params:{preset_id, config, input_video:{id, type:'video_input'}, start_seconds, end_seconds, target_fps, resolution, width, height}, client_meta:{credits, settings_type}}
mixedMedia.credits: floor(duration × fps) × 2 credits (× 4 at 4K), i.e. 2 credits per output frame. 10 s at 8 fps = 160 credits; 10 s at 24 fps 1K = 480
mixedMedia.insight: Cost per frame and the low default fps mean Mixed Media stylizes sampled frames (a stop-motion/collage look) rather than running a video model (inferred)
mixedMedia.presetCountNote: 33 presets in the sitemap and in the app's i18n name map; marketing copy says '40+'

instadump.pitch: Generate Your Instadump — Upload your favorite photos and build a pack to generate new images that look like you.

steps.detail: Pick a ready-made style pack (grid of pack cards, search) or 'Create new pack': upload up to 15 reference photos (PNG/JPG or paste), name the pack
Upload one selfie or photo (PNG/JPG/paste, <20 MB) — 'it'll be the base for your photodump styles'; or pick a saved character
Results grid: Download All / Download ({n}/{total}), per image Animate / Edit / Delete, Restart, Go to Library

copy.done: Get your Instadump — Your new photos are ready - download, post, share and enjoy!
copy.addPhoto: Use a clear, well-lit photo for best results.

instadump.api: POST /keyframes/v3/photo-dump-pack {params:{preset_id:'bc8c784e-dfab-4255-9952-e1a947a94983', width, height, aspect_ratio:'portrait', character_input_image:{id,url,type:'media_input',width,height}, pack_id, checkpoint:'260000', photodump_transform:false, quality:'1600p', sample_solver:'unipc', seed}}; packs GET/POST /photo-dump/packs
instadump.output: One image per pack reference (inferred), portrait at 1600p quality; free-generation counter job type 'instadump'
tips: Portrait-to-portrait works best (woman → woman, man → man)
Clear, high-resolution photo with a visible face

modes.Manual: prompt per scene ('Add scene', 'Write what happens in Scene {n}')
modes.Auto: one prompt + number of frames (up to 8)

popcorn.references: up to 4 images, referenced by number ('Man from image one…'); 'Note that reference images reduce the max output count.'
